01 — Profile

About

I'm a Management Information Systems candidate at Oklahoma State University (graduating August 2026, 3.78 GPA), focused on automation, systems integration, troubleshooting, and digital operations.

I build and operate real systems for live businesses and clients — an unattended Linux pipeline that publishes AI video content three times a day, a multi-account algorithmic trading and risk platform, a production ecommerce storefront, and the analytics and automation behind a working insurance agency. I like taking a system from broken or nonexistent to running, tested, and monitored.
